actual_model: Seat assignment supplied by parent; not independently observable
phase: final revision-2 specification and formal-boundary review
scope: Real egraph architecture, soundness boundary, typed relational rules, certificate replay and commercialization; no production writes or execution tests.

required_obligations.requirement: Every union preserves exact context and complete type/schema; hashcons identity contains closed operator tag, ordered canonical children, type, context and exact opaque payload. Hash equality alone is insufficient.

Rebuild iterates parent canonicalization and congruence collisions to fixed point; every collision merge has replayable congruence justification with historical child equality evidence. UF membership is never proof authority.
Finite rewrite registry distinguishes Boolean from relational/integer operators and checks repeated pattern variables by eclass identity. Safe relation laws require exact ordered schemas.
negative_cases: integer addition must not use union idempotence

required_obligations.requirement: Unsupported binders, lets, temporal and other operators remain whole opaque leaves; no descent, substitution, prenexing, operand reordering or rewriting inside them. Opaque identity must retain exact anonymous structure and lexical identity.
negative_cases: signature and bound variable with same spelling

required_obligations.requirement: Independent bounded certificate replay reconstructs concrete endpoints with trusted operator/rule registry and context, rejects unknown rules, forged substitutions, invalid intermediates, forward/cyclic references and endpoint mismatch. Do not validate certificate by querying producer UF.

Extractor returns finite acyclic expression with deterministic cost and lexical tie break plus root-to-output proof. Budgets separately bound matching, nodes, rewrite attempts, rebuild and replay; budget stop never claims complete semantic normal form.

Existing complete Shannon-table profile and atom inventory remain distinct from structural and extracted artifacts. Preserve initial ordered atom inventory even when output drops atoms. New rule model requires Lean proof before Java implementation; Lean model theorem does not establish parser or Java refinement.
negative_cases: p AND false reduces to false without losing original atom identity
distinct some A/some B inventories with equal abstract truth table

required_obligations.requirement: Preserve commercialization gate and exact dependency/license provenance. ACGN MIT permits reuse subject to notices but does not clear corpora or bundled dependencies. Existing Alloy metadata conflict and SAT4J LGPL remain unresolved release matters.

evidence_interpretation: ACGN semantic_soundness.md reports bounded corpus checks and targeted binder/temporal probes, not universal proof transferable to Allow.
ACGN Java-Lean refinement explicitly excludes universal heap/loop refinement and complete parser correspondence.
Current Allow Certificate is Boolean only; relational rules and congruence for new constructors require new formal obligations.

No production sources changed and no implementation tests were possible at this gate.

resolved: All eight architecture obligations are represented by the frozen revision-2 supplement.
Explicit ATOM inventory membership is checked against trusted adapter input; arbitrary alternate self-asserted inventories reject.
Term and proof dependency depths limited to 128; OUTPUT_LIMIT included.
Modulo-eclass matches require concrete substitutions and child congruence proofs before RULE admission.
Rule.notTrue and Rule.notFalse are present. MixedFormula/substB/MixedDerivation/mixed_sound cover Boolean rules instantiated by SOME/NO formulas plus relational congruence.
Twenty exact formal obligations include four closed concrete witnesses.
final_disposition.formal_evidence: Inspected supplement-r2/report.json: VERIFIED; two exit-zero builds with equal compiled artifact maps and audit hashes, 53 total/20 new model propositions, 34 mappings and 272 finite rule assignments, determinism PASS, no reported blockers or infrastructure errors. Did not rerun Lean independently.
scope_limits: Acceptance authorizes implementing this design; it is not acceptance of absent production code or UI.
Graph.justified is an assumed abstract invariant, not a proof of concrete union-find, rebuilding, matching or extraction algorithms.
Fixed tuple-carrier and finite-list mixed semantics require the runtime schema/AST correspondence gate; no universal Java or Alloy parser refinement is asserted.
The initial inventory/Boolean Shannon profile is not replaced by bounded egraph extraction.
